extra.final_summary: The data had several issues: (1) two misspelled species labels ('Chinstarp', 'Gentto') were corrected to 'Chinstrap' and 'Gentoo'; (2) whitespace variants in 'island' (' Biscoe', 'Biscoe ') were normalized to 'Biscoe'; (3) 'body_mass_g' was stored as text with commas and was converted to numeric; (4) two extreme outliers (3,700,000 and 3,475,000 grams) were excluded as they were far outside the valid range of 2500–6500 grams; (5) one exact duplicate row was removed. After fixes, the average body mass for females is 4017.74 grams and for males is 4385.16 grams.
